decisions.because: Counterexample (hunt round 3, 2026-10-10): signal, the target becomes a host address (claim suspended, ADR-0012), RETRACT answered 'OK nothing held' and broadcast nothing; when the address left the host the block came back on a reason the detector took back, and peers kept enforcing it.

statement: A retraction that removes an event's support retracts, mesh-wide, every own detector claim on the target that no remaining support holds, also one the protected set suspends now; such a claim does not come back when the target leaves the host.
